regime: Pause after forced selling in metals as a softer PPI eases, but doesn't end, Fed hike worries
takeaway: Gold bounced about 0.4% to near $3,892 after hitting a 13-month low Thursday, while silver stayed flat near $50 and the gold/silver ratio edged up toward 77.9. The October producer price report came in a little cooler than expected on the month, but yields stayed high (10-year near 5.13%) and the dollar index held above 103, so the Fed hike and gold short-term downtrend checks stay in view (gold is down about 6% in a month). Bitcoin slid below $70,000, while stock futures edged higher as Nvidia steadied.
